name: The St. Regis Al Mouj Muscat Resort
insider_take: Where Arabian heritage meets contemporary luxury on Oman's most prestigious waterfront destination.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits within Al Mouj, Oman's first integrated tourism complex, featuring the country's only 18-hole championship golf course designed by Greg Norman. The property showcases authentic Omani architecture with modern St. Regis sophistication, while the nearby Marina offers world-class dining and the largest sailing facility in the region.
pro_tip: Book a sunset sailing excursion from Al Mouj Marina - the views of Muscat's coastline and the Hajar Mountains are absolutely spectacular, especially during winter months when temperatures are perfect.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Iridium Spa treatments using frankincense (Oman's legendary export), and a visit to the nearby Qurum Beach - one of Muscat's most beautiful stretches of coastline. The hotel's prime location also provides easy access to Muscat's UNESCO World Heritage sites, including the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, just 15 minutes away.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with private beach access
Signature St. Regis butler service and luxury amenities
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
World-class spa and comprehensive wellness facilities
cons: Located outside central Muscat requiring transportation for city exploration
